key_insight: GateWatch turns a few binarized SAE features into explicit Boolean monitoring rules, approaching full SAE-probe accuracy with dramatically lower memory use.
engineering_relevance: GateWatchServe supports large numbers of concurrent LLM monitors with minimal inference-throughput and KV-cache impact.
method: Construct Boolean circuits over selected SAE features under a specified logic-gate budget.
Compute only selected features and stream their binary values across model layers.
Evaluate multiple classifiers in parallel using compact lookup tables.
evidence_signal: Across 24 tasks on Gemma-2-9B, GateWatch averaged 80.49% test accuracy with 3.8 features and 3.5 gates per probe—1.17 percentage points below full 16K-feature SAE probes—while reducing probe memory by 99.98%; 1,000 concurrent classifiers in vLLM retained 97–98% of baseline throughput and 99.8% of KV-cache capacity.
watch_item: Results are reported for Gemma-2-9B; accuracy and deployment overhead need validation on other models and monitoring tasks.
paper_title: GateWatch: Low-Overhead LLM Monitoring with Boolean Circuits
